{{Top|leg}}
A '''Laser Excitation Chamber''' was a weapon component used in [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms']] [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]] [[Anti-Infantry Turret|anti-infantry battery]]. It sat between the turret's [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] [[Gas chamber|chamber]] and the [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuator]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
